notes.title: Quarterly Release Updates.
notes.notes:
Subsequent Updates Planned Changes.
Starting after this update (28 July 2023), the
The group will change the update cycle to quarterly updates.
That's once every 3 months.
The main purpose of this change is to let you experience the content better.
The monthly updates are not enough to satisfy your playing experience.
We have received a lot of suggestions from players.
We have received a lot of suggestions from players, so we plan to change it to once a quarter.

ps: Answers to some questions
Q:Will you run away with quarterly updates?
A: Quarterly updates will not affect our update plan, we have an internal test plan.
We have an internal test project, because we need to fix bugs and content on a monthly basis, so the internal test project is updated on a monthly basis.
If you have any questions about the update or want to check the progress of the update, you can visit our qq group, or send us an email.
or send an email, thank you for your support!

Q:What is the beta programme? Do I need to pay for it?
A:Yes, there is an additional fee for the beta programme, which we have started.
The main purpose of the beta programme is to update our content and support our survival.
And the support of the beta programme will help us to maintain our confidence in the development of the game.
If you would like to participate in the beta programme, you can visit our Love Power page.
We would like to thank you for your support!
